description:
Founded in 1817, the University of Ghent is located in Ghent, Belgium, and is among the top 100 universities. It offers learning options across 11 faculties with 117 departments. Among the alumni of UGent are famous names such as Robert Cailliau, one of the inventors of the internet.

The University of Ghent is a public research university located in Ghent, Belgium.

Ghent University is abbreviated as UGent. UGent's motto is "Inter Utrumque" in Latin and means "between and between" in English. The first rector of the UGent was JC van Rotterdam.

Located in Flanders, the Dutch-speaking part of Belgium, and the cultural and economic center of Europe, the University of Ghent is an active partner in national and international educational, scientific and industrial cooperation. The University of Ghent is one of the top 100 universities and one of the largest Belgian universities.

UGent has an administrative staff strength of 9,000 and UZ Gent has an additional 6,000 staff. There are currently 41,000 students running a program at UGent. In 2017, UGent celebrated its 200th anniversary and the university has an annual revenue of €410M. Ghent University is one of the largest Flemish universities. UGent supports the University library and the University Hospital, one of Belgium's largest hospitals.
